name: geospatial
description: Geospatial methods for any source: resolve a place into one analysis region, get data from where it is served (ArcGIS REST, OGC WFS/WCS, STAC, remote rasters and lidar point clouds) bounded by that region with coverage checked against the data, and harmonize layers from different sources (CRS, units, time base, co-registration) into a recorded merge. Carries clio-kit's geoservices and geoprocess servers.
